newsitem.title: USA: Corp Express, United TransNet to merge.
newsitem.headline: Corp Express, United TransNet to merge.

text.p: Corporate Express Inc and United TransNet Inc said jointly Wednesday they have a definitive merger agreement.
The agreement calls for each share of United TransNet common stock to be exchanged for 0.45 of a share of Corporate Express common stock, according to a released statement.
Based on Corporate Express' closing stock price on September 10, United TransNet's stockholders would receive an initial per-share merger value of $14.73 and a market value of about $138 million.
The transaction is expected to be accretive to Corporate Express' earnings per share, and will increase its revenue "run-rate" to over $3 billion, the two companies said.
The acquisition of United TransNet will largely complete the national network of same-day delivery service for Corporate Express, they said.

United TransNet pro forma annual revenues for the most recently completed twelve month period ended June 30 were about $280 million. In March 1996, Corporate Express acquired U.S. Delivery Systems. Once the merger is complete, Corporate Express will have same-day local delivery operations in about 90 percent of the 100 largest metropolitan markets in the United States.

The merger is subject to approval by United TransNet stockholders, receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals, satisfactory confirmation that the merger will be treated as a tax-free reorganization and accounted for as a pooling of interests, and other conditions. The merger is expected to close before the end of 1996, the two companies said.
